jutsu.name: Light Barrier
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B39. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user raises a translucent shell of chakra around themselves, thin as rice paper but tightly woven. It catches the blows meant for them until it breaks.

jutsu.name: Wind Spear
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EA04. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user compresses the air into a narrow spear of wind chakra and drives it straight through %target. The point punches past their guard as if it were not there.

jutsu.name: Opening Strike
jutsu.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

jutsu.name: Cataclysm Fist
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B01. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user gathers chakra into one clenched fist until the air around it hums. They cross the distance in a single step and drive the blow into %target with the weight of a falling temple beam.

jutsu.name: Numbing Senbon
jutsu.description: A shot that briefly staggers.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flicks a senbon needle, its tip glinting, into a nerve point on %target. The strike can lock their muscles for a moment and leave them staggered.

jutsu.name: Harrying Shot
jutsu.description: Constant fire that gives no room to run.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user harries %target with relentless fire.

jutsu.name: Gale Bolt
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EA01. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a breath, shapes wind chakra into a spearpoint between two fingers, and fires it at %target. The gust strikes with a sharp crack, like a kite string snapping taut.

jutsu.name: Counter Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

jutsu.name: Warrior's Poise
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B19. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and settles their breathing, drawing chakra evenly through every limb. Their strikes come sharper and their guard stands firmer, the poise of a seasoned swordsman.

jutsu.name: Twin Kunai
jutsu.description: Two quick projectiles in succession.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

jutsu.name: Great Bell Toll
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B17. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together, and chakra rings out like a struck temple bell. The shockwave rolls over %target and everyone around them, leaving them reeling and unable to act.

jutsu.name: Bulwark Charge
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B23. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user crosses their arms and hardens a shell of chakra around themselves, bracing like a castle gate. Behind it they gather force for a heavier counterattack.

jutsu.name: Suppressing Roar
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B30. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a deep breath and releases a roar laced with chakra that shakes paper from the shoji. %target and everyone beside them are staggered, their attacks weakened by the force of it.

jutsu.name: Devouring Grasp
